brief:
Australia imposed targeted sanctions on three individuals and four entities involved in illegal settlement expansion and human rights violations against Palestinians in the West Bank, the human rights organization reported on November 18. The move marks an escalation in pressure against those responsible for settlement activities and abuses in occupied territory.

The sanctions follow a pattern of international accountability measures targeting settlers and Israeli officials accused of rights violations. Human Rights Watch documented the announcement amid ongoing tensions in the West Bank, where Israeli forces have engaged Palestinians and journalists covering military operations and settler activity.
dek: Israeli forces fire tear gas at Palestinians and journalists covering military operations and settler activity in the nearby village of Tal, in the West Bank, July 25, 2026. via AP Photo Australia announced on November 18 further targeted sanctions on three individuals and four entities involved in illegal settlement expansion and human rights abuses against Palestinians in the West Bank.
title: Australia sanctions Israeli settlers and entities for West Bank abuses
